verdict.line: You lose if you melee-trade into Riven's Q-W stun combo; you win if you stay in Cannon stance and poke her down before she ever gets to use it.

brief.thesis: Riven's entire kit is sub-275 range — Q (Broken Wings, 275), W (Ki Burst, 260), E (Valor, 250) — while Jayce's Cannon-stance Shock Blast reaches 600. The matchup is a question of whether Jayce respects that gap: lane advantage and solo-kill advantage both sit with Jayce (47.9% WR over 1034 games vs a 47.7% baseline), but the overall shape is even because one bad stance swap into her combo erases the lead instantly.

theirWindow.when: She has Q and E both up
theirWindow.what: With Broken Wings (13s CD) and Valor (10/9/8/7/6s CD) both available she can dash in, block your poke with E, and chain into W (Ki Burst) for the stun. Do not stand still or extend when you see both ready.

yourWindow.when: Her Q and E are both down
yourWindow.what: She has no dash and no damage-block left — this is when you step up and free-hit with autos and Q (To the Skies! / Shock Blast), or swap to Hammer stance and all-in with Q leap into E (Thundering Blow) knockback.

start.why: Highest-played start (93.3% pick, 47.5% WR) — the extra HP and sustain absorb the chip damage from Riven's empowered autos while you poke from range.

boots.why: Best-performing boots here (48% WR, 56.4% pick) — flattens the burst from her Runic Blade-empowered autos during an all-in.

Active haste gives you the speed to reset distance or chase after an E knockback.

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-measured page here (48.4% WR) — stacks off your ranged autos and Q hits during extended poke exchanges, giving you the durability to match her all-in instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the best-performing combo in this matchup (51% WR) — it lets you bank your range-poke wave advantage and still contest objectives, which matters since Riven clears waves worse than you siege them.

playing.title: Live in Cannon stance
playing.detail: Hold Cannon stance and poke at 600 range with Shock Blast. Only swap to Hammer stance when you're actually committing to a kill — point-blank is her game, not yours.

playing.title: Count her Q charges
playing.detail: Broken Wings is a 13s-cooldown, 3-charge dash. Once she's burned all three reactivations without landing a kill, she has no mobility for several seconds — step up and punish.

playing.title: Don't feed Valor
playing.detail: Valor (10/9/8/7/6s CD) lets her dash forward and block incoming damage. If it's up, holding your Shock Blast is better than feeding her a free block.

playing.title: Knock her out with E
playing.detail: Thundering Blow (20/18/16/14/12s CD) knocks her back 240 range the instant she closes distance — use it to reset to your max range rather than trading in melee.

playing.title: Snowball pre-6 kill windows
playing.detail: Before level 6 she has no Wind Slash execute. Trade freely at range and look to convert Jayce's measured solo-kill advantage into an early lead.

playing.title: Watch her Conqueror stacks
playing.detail: Per the matchup data, Riven leans on Conqueror sustain in long fights — disengage once she's stacked up rather than grinding a trade you already won.

playing.title: Use Teleport for tempo
playing.detail: Since she clears waves worse than you siege, bank side-lane plates and Teleport back to contest objectives instead of matching her in skirmishes you don't need.

brief.patchCaveat: All items, runes, summoners, and win rates here are measured OP.GG numbers from games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning (cooldown windows, range gaps, combo timing) is my own tactical read, not a measured stat.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Use your ranged pokes or use To the Skies! (Q) to deal damage and gain the upper hand.
